title: WinUI 3 override (metadata/overrides/winui/<Class>.yaml)
description: Per-class annotations for the WinUI backend. Members are named by their native winmd names; the generator derives JS names (kebab-case) and checks every name against metadata/winui. Members of a class apply to every element kind whose base chain contains it. Every manual fact carries provenance.

element.description: Present when the class is an element kind (must be constructible per winmd)

tag.description: Defaults to the class name in kebab-case; anything else needs tag_reason

text_content.description: Native prop that Text children of the element set

as.description: Expose an object-typed prop as a boxed value of this type

test.description: Value the generated test writes and reads back

sync.description: Deliver through host->call_sync while the native handler runs

prop.description: Settable bool on the args set to true when the handler answers true (preventDefault)

close.description: The window close rule of ABI v2: veto (args.Handled) and post while JS listens, else report SVL_GONE_CLOSED

name.description: Argument name in docs and typings

trigger.description: How the generated test raises the event: automation-peer invoke, or setting a prop

asynchronous.description: The toolkit raises the event later, not inside the triggering call

prop.description: Native property: a single child (object/UIElement) or a UIElementCollection

attached.description: Attached properties of this class used as per-child attributes of a slot (ABI v2.2 child attrs)

name.description: Attached property name (static Get<Name>/Set<Name> in winmd)
